name: Raspberry Tarantula | 1g
description:
Bright raspberry with a slightly tart finish. Hybrid, leaning toward the relaxing side. The berry flavor is clean and true-to-fruit — no artificial candy notes here. Easy smoke that tastes good from start to finish.

* Liquid Diamond Infused: Injected with concentrate for amplified potency.
* Kief Crusted: Rolled in kief for an extra layer of flavor and THC.
